proposed_facts.reason: Parent state-5 physics delegates animation-derived velocity, whereas child physics applies selected-line movement. Attack_Phys meaningfully distinguishes these implementations and resolves the rendered name collision without claiming historical spelling.

Canonical short-circuit queries use release-to-bottom followed by top-to-release. Both failures skip spawning; success immediately dereferences the spawn result. The accessory command is cleared before the attempt.

The shared helper performs movement processing before testing its countdown, decrements on the false path, and restores scale on the nonpositive path. The caller's state-1 transition and callbacks match the proposal; scale-phase progression is separate.

Nullable-child translation extraction, the false-result transition to state 5, and callback installation match source. Generic item physics establishes b3 as a gate for configured boundary destruction, not an attack-enable flag.

The collision wrapper always returns false after shared processing. Position synchronization, conditional floor recording, flag responses, empty callback and scale restoration are supported. Activation independently tests the physics countdown.

Construction persists the selected line ID and child physics conditionally applies its movement. The fallback query can select geometry above release height, invalidating the previous beneath-only restriction.

contradictions.reason: Accept the parent-name supersession: parent and child physics are distinct, and retaining the supported child name while changing only the parent resolves the rendered collision.
Accept both query-order and beneath-only supersessions. The fallback starts at the top boundary, not the release position; successful construction has no local allocation-result guard.

Accept false-path and appearance-completion supersessions. Physics activation uses a mutating countdown helper, not completion of the separate scale-phase machine. Retain the supported collision behavior.
Accept the b3 correction while retaining supported root-motion and transition flow. The generic consumer gates configured boundary-removal checks.
Accept the a33e21f0 compiled-layout deferral. Six parent source records and one child record do not establish compiled record size, contiguity or a 112-byte section.

Accept the ff7d646b, b66ff959, 78741f73 and 4f25a078 compiled-pool deferrals. Source supports literal consumers, not section size, allocation, placement, padding or compiled loads. The descent test zeros velocity below a threshold rather than clamping position.
